verdict.rationale: Blaxel Jobs are documented as a first-party batch-processing capability that runs many AI tasks in parallel, on demand or on a schedule, and scales automatically. That covers bulk execution across many work items. The evidence does not show bulk management of platform resources, such as acting on many sandboxes, files or deployments in one operation, nor how a batch's items are defined or fanned out. Missing for 10: bulk actions across many resources at once, documented batch input/fan-out semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Jobs allow you to run many AI tasks in parallel using batch processing.
Run batch processing tasks for AI workflows on Blaxel as scheduled or on-demand jobs that scale automatically and run on serverless infrastructure.
